definitions.signal: Native full-selected MC generated; Gaussian full-template fitted. Gaussian-log controls separate.
definitions.logshift: Fit and training-exclusion mask share log-displaced center; nominal resolution retained.
definitions.mu0: Calibration mean null Wald pull Ahat/sigma; mean-pull centering is diagnostic and differs from fixed yield offset.
definitions.delta: Calibration mean null fitted yield in full-selected candidate units.
definitions.R: Calibration paired MC response at z3; not tail acceptance or detector efficiency.
definitions.rank: Raw Ahat lower-tail p=(1+k)/101; reject<=0.10; grid endpoints only, right-censor at24s0.
definitions.p0: Raw Ahat upper-tail add-onep, with separate k/100 binomial95%CP interval; pointwise fixed source.
definitions.bootstrap: Whole IDs across masses/policies/levels; independent source streams; frozen pilot scale.
definitions.coverage: Rank size<=10/101 marginal over calibration and independent evaluation at fixed generator; frozen tables checked separately.

limitations: Conditional fixed-source and fixed-empirical-template diagnostics, not global calibration or physical exclusion.
